evidence: decorative_mascot: Data stands beside a console in the hook (hook@0.8 to seg0:end) and just perches on the probe in seg1:mid. In seg2:mid he stands still next to a plunger box. In seg3:mid he waves under a stopwatch floating over his head. He never causes the motion: the probe flies, the plume grows

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: The closing (seg4:start to seg4:end) is a dense six-line text block over a probe tilting past an empty seat, while Data stands at a lever doing nothing. The video then cuts to a near-black void with Data holding a blank price tag (payoff@-0.4).
weakest_scene.root_cause: A generic fallback end card with a default blank price-tag prop is appended after the closing scene. The closing scene also has no bit for Data, and its payoff is carried by a text dump, not the picture.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Remove the dark price-tag end card and let the closing picture hold to the last frame. Make Data the cause: he pulls the lever and the empty-seat probe blasts off, he is left on the ground looking up, and the empty seat is the payoff. Cut the on-screen closing text to one short line so the picture is readable.
